newsitem.title: USA: Danninger gets FDA nod on spinal system.
newsitem.headline: Danninger gets FDA nod on spinal system.

text.p: Danninger Medical Technology Inc said Monday its Cross Medical Products Inc unit had received 510(K) marketing clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for the synergy posterior titanium spinal system.
The anterior titanium portion of this spinal system received similar clearance in October 1995, it said.
The company said it currently markets the system with implants manufactured from stainless steel, as well as titanium implants for anterior use.
Its spinal system allows surgeons to treat degenerative disease, deformities, and trauma in any area of the lumbar and thoracic spine, it said.
